'''Vall Kumauri's flagship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Vall Kumauri]]. When Kumauri's conquests of approximately [[10,000 BBY]] led to a [[Galactic Republic–Kumauri Empire war|conflict]] between [[Kumauri Empire|his empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] participated in a [[Battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic|battle]] between the two factions. Both the battle and Kumauri's flagship were eventually depicted in a fresco in a [[Kumauri palace|Kumauri Empire palace]] on an [[Unidentified Outer Rim moon|Outer Rim Territories moon]].

==History==
[[Vall Kumauri]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by Vall Kumauri,<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" /> a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> who lived during the [[Ductavis Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] lasting from approximately [[11,000 BBY]] to [[9000 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Amassing a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of new [[Kumauri Battleship|battleships]]<ref name="CRO" /> he had designed and created,<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|30|TRA 1-4|Tractor Beams}}</ref> Kumauri conquered several dozen [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="CRO" /> around [[10,000 BBY]],<ref name="10,000 BBY" /> giving rise to the [[Kumauri Empire]].<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" /> The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] eventually engaged in a brief [[Galactic Republic–Kumauri Empire war|conflict]] with Kumauri's empire,<ref name="EGTW" /> and his flagship participated in a [[Battle between the Kumauri Empire and the Republic|battle]] between the two powers. At some point, both the battle and the starship were depicted in a fresco in a [[Kumauri palace|Kumauri Empire palace]] on an [[Unidentified Outer Rim moon|Outer Rim Territories moon]].<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" /> Kumauri's empire was ultimately defeated by the Republic and imploded within a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the former's creation.<ref name="CRO" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
The civilization created by Kumauri had become almost forgotten<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" /> by [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643 BBY">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "The Palace of the Kumauri" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> when the palace on the Outer Rim [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was discovered. An individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] eventually sent a companion to explore the structure, and the latter discovered the fresco depicting Kumauri's flagship.<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vall Kumauri's flagship was mentioned in an Archaeology Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="The Palace of the Kumauri" />
